rows: Learn how to troubleshoot memory issues
Instance Memory Consumption > 80% and App Service Plan has less than 2 GB of total RAM

<markdown>Most of the times when overall instance memory was high, the app was running on an instance that had less than 2 GB of total RAM. Out of the total physical memory, some memory is used by System services and other infrastructure processes to run as well.  If this is a production app and your app has high memory requirement, consider scaling up to the next tier.
</markdown>
